name: Shibboleth
source:
The cult in which Cassidy Attaway spent most of her life was right: the end of the world finally came. At first, Cass tries to outrun the apocalypse; however, once she crosses paths with her sister, May, now changed into an angelic being, she's given a choice on which hinges her eternal life.

[from [url=https://naarel.itch.io/shibboleth]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡西迪·阿塔韦大半生所在的邪教，竟然说对了：世界末日终于来临。起初，卡斯试图逃过末日；可当她与已经化为天使般存在的姐妹梅相遇后，她面临一个决定自己永恒生命的选择。

[摘自[url=https://naarel.itch.io/shibboleth]itch.io[/url]]
